profile.name: Alicat质量流量计
profile.description: Alicat质量流量计是一种用于气体流量测量的实验室仪表，通常可同时提供质量流量、体积流量、压力和温度读数，并可进行气体种类选择、零点校准和累计量管理。它常用于气体供给、混气、工艺监测和各类气体实验系统。
profile.description_en: An Alicat mass flow meter is a laboratory instrument for measuring gas flow. It typically provides mass flow, volumetric flow, pressure, and temperature readings, and may support gas selection, zeroing, and totalizer management. It is commonly used in gas delivery, gas mixing, process monitoring, and general gas-handling experimental systems.
